(module
  (import "env" "log" (func $log (param i32)))
  (memory (export "memory") 1)
  (global $counter (mut i32) (i32.const 0))
  (data (i32.const 8) "hello\n")
  (type $binop (func (param i32 i32) (result i32)))

  (; block
     comment ;)
  (func $add (export "add") (type $binop) (param $a i32) (param $b i32) (result i32)
    (local $tmp i64)
    (local.set $tmp (i64.extend_i32_u (local.get $a)))
    (block $exit
      (loop $again
        (br_if $exit (i32.eqz (local.get $b)))
        (global.set $counter (i32.add (global.get $counter) (i32.const 1)))
        (local.set $b (i32.sub (local.get $b) (i32.const 1)))
        (br $again)))
    (if (result i32) (i32.gt_s (local.get $a) (i32.const -5))
      (then (local.get $a))
      (else (f32.const 1.5e2) (drop) (i32.const 0xff))))
  (start $add)
)
